name: Bold sans + gold italic emphasis
best_for: Story-plus-framework reels about AI, launches and tools (60-105 s): a claim hook, three labelled steps, comment-keyword CTA.
notes: Everything lowercase. Three type voices: white bold tight grotesque, butter-yellow italic serif for keywords (1.3-2x size), and handwriting asides. ~25% of words are emphasised. Captions build into cumulative stacks and clear. Hero stacks pair huge white bold with huge yellow italic. Back half of each reel is caption-only (13-19 s stretches). Person-matte text-behind-head is used in the originals and NOT implemented here.
